verdict.rationale: Stripe's Agentic Commerce Suite lets merchants sell through agents with a single integration. Sellers onboard from the Dashboard, publish a CSV product catalog, approve each agent, and receive orders as `checkout.session.completed` events tagged with the originating agent. Buyers "complete purchases without leaving the conversation," and ChatGPT is named as the first platform implementing ACP. The caveats are significant: the suite is in private preview, the custom ACP path is waitlisted and US-only, it supports physical goods only in listed countries, ChatGPT participation requires an application, and no evidence names Claude, Gemini or Copilot as live surfaces. Missing for 10: general availability, documented live integrations with Claude/Gemini/Copilot and peers beyond ChatGPT, support beyond physical goods, independent hands-on corroboration of completed in-chat purchases.
